turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, then I'm on a client call. Owen learned about a zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me before it went in. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
Before I came in today. The zero went in on November 3rd, so what did you have before that, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then she'll put it in writing, and I'll read it. "Policy is policy," you said, so let's read it together: 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. Which part of your own policy did you follow, Hale?
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.

"A courtesy." I'm writing that down, along with the fact that you still haven't answered my question. Either you show me what you had on November 3rd besides a machine's guess, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
